source_text: Iebusaeum habitantem in Ierusalem non potuerunt expellere — remanet in nobis quod expugnandum. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Jebusite dwelling in Jerusalem not they-could drive-out — remains in us what to-be-stormed. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[They could not drive out the Jebusite dwelling in Jerusalem >> Bible:Joshua 15:63]] — something remains in us still to storm. Amen.
